Here are the KEY REQUIREMENTS for Typst 0.11+ syntax:

1. **All `#let` function definitions MUST be at module level (before any `#set` or `#page` calls)**
2. **Function parameters use positional style**: `#let day-page(num, date, title-zh, title-en, subtitle, accent-color, image-path, body-left, body-right, image-height: 7.5cm, star: false) = {...}`
3. **ALL call sites use NAMED arguments**: `#day-page(num: "01", date: "Monday, June 2", body-left: [...], body-right: [...], image-path: "images/yangmingshan.jpg", star: false, image-height: 7.5cm, ...)` - named args can be in any order
4. **Gradient stops use percentages**: `gradient.linear((C-navy, 0%), (C-navy, 100%), angle: 280deg)` - first stop MUST be 0%, last stop MUST be 100%
5. **No `uppercase:` argument on text()** - remove it
6. **No `align:` argument on text()** - wrap in `#align(center)[...]`
7. **Background colors need a box**: `background: { box(fill: C-warm, width: 100%, height: 100%) }`
8. **No `#bullet-item` built-in** - define it as a helper function at module level
9. **No `Arial Black` font** - just use "Arial" with weight 900
10. **Opacify uses percentage**: `C-navy.opacify(65%)` not `.opacify(0.65)`
11. **`#` is NOT valid inside content blocks (inside `[]` after `#page[`, `#box[`, etc.)** - only valid in code context at module level
12. **`$` characters in text content get interpreted as math mode** - use `NT` instead of `NT$` or escape with raw text

The file should contain:
- Color constants: C-navy (#0a1628), C-coral (#e63946), C-gold (#f4a261), C-teal (#2a9d8f), C-green (#52b788), C-muted (#8d99ae), C-light (#f4f4f4), C-white (#ffffff), C-text (#1a1a2e), C-warm (#f7ede2)

- Helper function `schedule-table(accent, rows)` at module level that takes accent color and array of (time, schedule) tuples
- Helper function `day-entry(num, day-color, label-en, label-zh, subtitle)` at module level
- `day-page(num, date, title-zh, title-en, subtitle, accent-color, image-path, body-left, body-right, image-height: 7.5cm, star: false)` function at module level
- Cover page (full-bleed image background, gradient overlay, large typography "台北之旅", day preview pills, stats row)
- Table of Contents page (warm background, day entries with colored bars, practical info, booking checklist)
- Day pages 01-07 (full-bleed hero images, gradient fade, two-column layout with schedule table on left and highlights on right)

- Closing page

All images exist in `images/` directory: cover-taipei.jpg, yangmingshan.jpg, hydrangea.jpg, beitou.jpg, ximending.jpg, leofoo.jpg, jiufen.jpg, zoo.jpg, maokong.jpg

// taipei-trip.typ — 台北之旅 · June 2-8, 2026
// Professional Travel Magazine Edition
// Typst 0.11+ compatible syntax

// ─── COLOR CONSTANTS ────────────────────────────────────────
#let C-navy  = rgb("#0a1628")
#let C-coral = rgb("#e63946")
#let C-gold  = rgb("#f4a261")
#let C-teal  = rgb("#2a9d8f")
#let C-green = rgb("#52b788")
#let C-muted = rgb("#8d99ae")
#let C-light = rgb("#f4f4f4")
#let C-white = rgb("#ffffff")
#let C-text  = rgb("#1a1a2e")
#let C-warm  = rgb("#f7ede2")

// ─── HELPER FUNCTIONS ───────────────────────────────────────

// bullet-item helper — creates a bullet point with custom styling
#let bullet-item(txt) = {
  box()[#h(8pt) + box(width: 5pt, height: 5pt, radius: 50%, fill: C-muted) + h(4pt) + txt]
}

// chip / info badge — small label-value pair
#let chip(label: "", val: "", accent: C-teal) = box(
  radius: 4pt,
  inset: (x: 6pt, y: 2.5pt),
  fill: accent.lighten(90%),
)[
  #text(size: 7.5pt, weight: 700, fill: accent)[#label]
  #h(2pt)
  #text(size: 7.5pt, fill: C-text)[#val]
]

// schedule-table — creates a styled schedule with time/schedule rows
#let schedule-table(accent: C-teal, rows: ()) = {
  table(
    columns: (1.3cm, 1fr),
    inset: (x: 5pt, y: 4.5pt),
    stroke: (x, y) => if y == 0 { none } else { 0.3pt },
    fill: (x, y) => if y == 0 {
      accent.lighten(25%)
    } else if calc.even(y) { C-light } else { C-white },
    align: (left, left),
    text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: accent)[TIME], text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: accent)[SCHEDULE],
    ..rows.map(r => (
      text(size: 8.5pt, weight: 700, fill: accent)[#r.at(0)],
      text(size: 9pt, fill: C-text)[#r.at(1)],
    )).flatten()
  )
}

// day-entry — single row for table of contents
#let day-entry(num: "01", day-color: C-teal, label-en: "", label-zh: "", subtitle: "") = {
  let row = grid(
    columns: (0.35cm, 2.5cm, 1fr, 2.5cm),
    column-gutter: 8pt,
    align: (center, left, left, right),
    box(width: 0.25cm, height: 0.9cm, fill: day-color, radius: 2pt),
    text(size: 11pt, weight: 900, fill: day-color)[#num],
    [
      #text(size: 10pt, weight: 800, fill: C-navy)[#label-en]
      #v(1pt)
      #text(size: 10pt, weight: 600, fill: C-muted)[#label-zh]
    ],
    text(size: 9pt, fill: C-muted)[#subtitle],
  );
  let sep = v(6pt) + box(width: 100%, height: 0.5pt, fill: C-muted.lighten(60%)) + v(6pt);
  row + sep
}

// day-page template — full-bleed hero with two-column body
#let day-page(
  num: "01",
  date: "Monday, June 2",
  title-zh: "",
  title-en: "",
  subtitle: "",
  accent-color: C-teal,
  image-path: "images/yangmingshan.jpg",
  body-left: [],
  body-right: [],
  image-height: 7.5cm,
  star: false,
) = {
  page(paper: "a4", margin: (top: 0pt, bottom: 0pt, x: 0pt))[
    // Full-bleed hero image
    #box(clip: true, width: 100%, height: image-height)[
      #image(image-path, width: 100%, height: image-height, fit: "cover")
    ]

    // Gradient fade
    #box(width: 100%, height: 0.8cm, fill: gradient.linear(
      (C-navy, 0%),
      (C-navy, 100%),
      angle: 270deg,
    ))

    // Content area
    #box(fill: C-white, width: 100%, padding: (x: 1.8cm, top: 0.5cm, bottom: 1.4cm))[
      // Header
      #grid(
        columns: (1fr, auto, auto),
        column-gutter: 8pt,
        align: (left, left, right),
        [
          #text(size: 9pt, weight: 700, fill: accent-color, tracking: 3pt)[
            #box(width: 0.4cm, height: 0.5cm, fill: accent-color, radius: 2pt)
            #h(4pt)
            DAY #num
          ]
          #text(size: 9pt, fill: C-muted, tracking: 1pt)[#date]
        ],
        if star [
          #box(radius: 4pt, inset: (x: 8pt, y: 3pt), fill: C-gold)[
            #text(size: 8pt, weight: 700, fill: C-navy)[STAR ATTRACTION]
          ]
        ],
        [],
      )
      #v(2pt)

      // Title
      #text(size: 24pt, weight: 900, fill: C-navy, font: "Arial")[#title-zh]
      #v(1pt)
      #text(size: 10pt, weight: 500, fill: C-muted, tracking: 1pt)[#title-en]
      #v(1pt)
      #text(size: 8.5pt, fill: C-muted)[#subtitle]

      #v(8pt)
      #box(width: 100%, height: 1.5pt, fill: accent-color)
      #v(10pt)

      // Two-column body
      #grid(
        columns: (38%, 62%),
        column-gutter: 14pt,
        align: (top, top),
        body-left,
        body-right,
      )
    ]
  ]
}

// ─── PAGE DEFAULTS ───────────────────────────────────────────
#set page(paper: "a4", margin: (top: 0pt, bottom: 0pt, x: 0pt))

// ─── COVER PAGE ─────────────────────────────────────────────
#set page(
  paper: "a4",
  background: {
    place(top + left, scope: "parent", {
      box(width: 100%, height: 100%)[
        #image("images/cover-taipei.jpg", width: 100%, height: 100%, fit: "cover")
      ]
    })
    place(top + left, scope: "parent", {
      box(width: 100%, height: 100%, fill: gradient.linear(
        (C-navy, 0%),
        (C-navy, 50%),
        (C-navy, 70%),
        (C-navy, 100%),
        angle: 280deg,
      ))
    })
  }
)

[
  #v(3.8cm)
  #align(center)[
    #text(size: 9pt, weight: 400, fill: C-gold, tracking: 5pt)[TRAVEL GUIDE · 2026]
    #v(8pt)
    #text(size: 72pt, weight: 900, fill: C-white, font: "Arial")[台北]
    #text(size: 72pt, weight: 300, fill: C-gold, font: "Arial")[之旅]
    #v(6pt)
    #text(size: 22pt, weight: 300, fill: C-white, tracking: 8pt)[TAIPEI JOURNEY]

    #box(width: 8cm, height: 2pt, fill: C-gold)
    #v(10pt)
    #text(size: 12pt, fill: C-light, tracking: 3pt)[JUNE 2 — 8, 2026 · 7 DAYS · 4 TRAVELERS]

        text(size: 8pt, weight: 700, fill: C-gold)[D3],
        text(size: 8pt, weight: 700, fill: C-coral)[D4],
        text(size: 8pt, weight: 700, fill: C-teal)[D5],
        text(size: 8pt, weight: 700, fill: C-gold)[D6],
        text(size: 8pt, weight: 700, fill: C-green)[D7],
        text(size: 8pt, fill: C-light)[冷水坑],
        text(size: 8pt, fill: C-light)[繡球花],
        text(size: 8pt, fill: C-light)[北投],
        text(size: 8pt, fill: C-light)[夜市],
        text(size: 8pt, fill: C-light)[六福村],
        text(size: 8pt, fill: C-light)[九份猴硐],
        text(size: 8pt, fill: C-light)[貓空],
      )
    ]
  ]

  #v(1.6cm)
  #align(center)[
    #grid(
      columns: (auto, auto, auto),
      column-gutter: 28pt,
      align: (center, center, center),
      text(size: 28pt, weight: 900, fill: C-gold)[7],
      text(size: 28pt, weight: 900, fill: C-gold)[6],
      text(size: 28pt, weight: 900, fill: C-gold)[1],
    )
    #v(2pt)
    #grid(
      columns: (auto, auto, auto),
      column-gutter: 28pt,
      align: (center, center, center),
      text(size: 8pt, weight: 600, fill: C-muted, tracking: 2pt)[DAYS],
      text(size: 8pt, weight: 600, fill: C-muted, tracking: 2pt)[NIGHTS],
      text(size: 8pt, weight: 600, fill: C-muted, tracking: 2pt)[CITIES],
    )
  ]
]

// ─── TABLE OF CONTENTS ──────────────────────────────────────
#set page(paper: "a4", margin: (top: 1.6cm, bottom: 1.6cm, x: 1.8cm))
#page(background: { box(fill: C-warm, width: 100%, height: 100%) })[
  #v(-4pt)
  #box(width: 100%, height: 1.8cm, fill: C-navy)[
    #align(center + horizon)[
      #text(size: 9pt, fill: C-gold, tracking: 5pt, weight: 600)[CONTENTS]
      #h(10pt)
      #text(size: 9pt, fill: C-light, tracking: 5pt)[目錄]

  ]

  #v(18pt)

  #day-entry(num: "01", day-color: C-teal, label-en: "Cold Water Pit", label-zh: "冷水坑 · 擎天崗步道", subtitle: "Yangmingshan National Park · Free")
  #day-entry(num: "02", day-color: C-coral, label-en: "Hydrangea Season", label-zh: "竹子湖繡球花季", subtitle: "Zhuzihu · Seasonal Bloom")

  #day-entry(num: "07", day-color: C-green, label-en: "Zoo × Maokong Gondola", label-zh: "市立動物園 · 貓空纜車", subtitle: "Final Day · Farewell Taipei")

  #v(10pt)
  #box(width: 100%, height: 0.5pt, fill: C-muted.lighten(60%))
  #v(10pt)

  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, 1fr),
